text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, Brian.
The doctor said I won't be able to run with you for a while.

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But there are plenty of others for you to run with out there.
So don't worry about me, go have fun.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Girl A
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... Brian-chan,
you're too faaast...!

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I can go even faster next time, though.
So let's run one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Girl B
text_block_list.text:
...G-Give me a break!
It might be fun for you when you win, but it's not fun for me at all!

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Girl B
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... You're just too strong...
I hate you, I hate you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Girl A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Brian-chan? Do you want to come to our racing academy next time?
There are tons of amazing runners there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few years later, at a certain racing academy—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Racing Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian really has phenomenal form.
Though I hear she's bounced around quite a few academies already.

text_block_list.name: Racing Instructor B
text_block_list.text:
I honestly can't fathom why. With talent like hers,
you'd think any school would bend over backward to keep her...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...I can't... anymore...
This seriously sucks... Why'd someone that fast have to join our class...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(...No, not like that! Challenge me!!
Isn't this supposed to be a race?! Why give up so easily—)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Impossi-ble... Ahh, even if I go all out, there's no way I can match her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —I'm quitting. As of today.

text_block_list.name: Racing Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! Why?! Isn't this place so much better than your last academy?!
We have a regulation-size track and offer much higher-level practical training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No. I find no satisfaction here.
...Competing in races devoid of passion is utterly meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...So this is where you were, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come to Tracen Academy. There, you will find real racing.
...And perhaps, satisfy that thirst of yours.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And they're off! The Tracen Academy Selection Race has begun!
Number 6 bursts out in front!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Number 8, Narita Brian, watches like a hawk, waiting for her chance!
Meanwhile, Number 6 widens the gap even further!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl #6
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl #6
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (Is it the same story here, too?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...No matter where I go, no matter whom I face,
I remain unsatisfied. The thirst only deepens.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, then staying here is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They say taking a walk is great for clearing one's head.
While strolling alone along the riverbank that day...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text: Are you really sure you want to do this?

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I never want to repeat a blunder like that again.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was the girl who had raced against Narita Brian before.
Perhaps they were training out here as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, pardon me for startling you out of the blue.
I am Biwa Hayahide. Narita Brian's elder sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I happened to spot the trainer rumored to persistently pursue Brian
despite being turned down time and time again. I was eager to speak with you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Please, there is no need to be so nervous.
Would you mind sparing a bit of your time?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew, time to cool down.
I'd appreciate it if you could record the final lap time in blue ink.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Before I knew it, I had ended up helping out with her training session.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, we gathered some excellent data. The wind sprints you suggested
at the end were quite sharp. Born from always considering areas for improvement, I take it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Above all, your dedication to staying out this late shows you put horsegirls first.
...Yes, you'll do nicely.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we move on to the main topic?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me. I was testing you. According to my theories,
one's approach to training reflects their true character.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware it was presumptuous of me. But I simply had to know.
Whether you were someone worthy of entrusting with my wish.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Please, would you bring my sister, Narita Brian,
to watch my Make Debut race?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I heard a troubling rumor the other day.
I want to show her a real race before it's too late.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Before she finalizes her decision to drop out.
